req.title: Delete only by author
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 403 Forbidden when a user attempts to delete a post they did not author.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that only the author of a post should be able to delete it. This necessitates testing both positive and negative scenarios to ensure that unauthorized users receive a 403 Forbidden response, while the author receives a successful response. Boundary testing is also essential to ensure that the system behaves correctly at the edges of valid input ranges.

tests.name: test_author_can_delete_own_post
preconditions: Post with id 1 exists and is authored by James
actions: Send POST request to /1/delete as James
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as James
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'James', 'password': 'river'})

# Attempt to delete post 1
r = client.post('/1/delete')

# Assert successful deletion
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_non_author_cannot_delete_post
preconditions: Post with id 1 exists and is authored by James
actions: Send POST request to /1/delete as Rahul
tests.executable:

import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
